measures.title: Riverside County Traffic Relief, Pothole/Road Repair Investment Renewal
measures.summary: Placed on the ballot by the Riverside County Transportation Commission, this measure would continue the existing voter-approved half-cent transportation sales tax in Riverside County, without raising tax rates, until ended by voters. The ballot question says it would provide about $280,000,000 a year for reducing congestion, repairing potholes and roads, completing freeway projects, reinforcing bridges and highways against flooding and earthquakes, and keeping senior, student, disabled and veteran bus fares low, with audits and spending disclosure required.
measures.yesMeans: The existing transportation sales tax continues, with no end date unless voters end it, to fund the listed road, freeway and transit purposes.
measures.noMeans: The existing transportation sales tax is not extended by this measure.
